method: Poll real five-peer /ui/status during 48-frame render; count simultaneous GPU assignments; validate encoded frame count from Blender movie clip and download MP4. Timings are workflow wall clock excluding holds, not scheduler latency.
pause_restart_checks: Six-frame validation passed pause/resume, restart after completion, restart during GPU execution, preserved old output.
limitations: One laptop/Iris Xe, three logical GPU processes; unmeasured heat quotas; weights are not GPU percentages or guaranteed frame shares; one run is not an SLA.
